title: there's no warnings or errors after failed to set validate_password_length to 0

comments.text:
Description:
there's no warnings or errors after failed to set validate_password_length to 0

i know to set validate_password_length to 0,i shall set validate_password_mixed_case_count, validate_password_number_count, validate_password_special_char_count to 0 and set validate_password_policy to low firstly, then  validate_password_length can be successfully set to 0 and it works

However, if i set validate_password_length to 0 directly, there's no warnings and errors to remind me that this parameter i set just doesn't work

Hello yujie wang,

Thank you for the report and feedback.
Please note that **validate_password plugin** system variable is deprecated; expect it to be removed in a future version of MySQL hence used the validate_password.length system variable of the *validate_password component* instead and confirmed that it is logging the message to the error log when attempted to set 0 to validate_password.length system variable of the *validate_password component*.

Looking at the error log -

2023-07-25T08:05:28.225015Z 7 [Warning] [MY-011234] [Server] Effective value of validate_password_length is changed. New value is 4

Quoting from official manual " The validate_password.length minimum value is a function of several other related system variables. The value cannot be set less than the value of this expression:

validate_password.number_count
+ validate_password.special_char_count
+ (2 * validate_password.mixed_case_count)

If validate_password adjusts the value of validate_password.length due to the preceding constraint, it writes a message to the error log. "

So, this is working as expected. Marking this as a not bug for now.
